name: ERF archive
holds: Generic encapsulated resource archive. MOD and SAV are ERF variants.

name: Module archive
holds: A module's mutable resources, dropped into Modules/.

name: Savegame container
holds: ERF variant holding a saved game's party, journal and world state.

name: RIM archive
holds: Read-only resource archive. The static half of every module.

name: BIF bulk data
holds: Bulk resource blob referenced by chitin.key. The game's 1.1 GB of base content.

name: KEY index
holds: chitin.key -- the master index into the BIFs. Also the install-root sentinel.

name: 2DA table
holds: Game rules tables: appearance, baseitems, feat, spells, itempropdef.

name: Talk table
holds: dialog.tlk -- every localised string in the game, indexed by StrRef.

name: GFF tree
holds: BioWare struct/field tree. The backbone under every template below.

name: Creature template
holds: A creature: stats, feats, inventory, appearance, scripts.

name: Item template
holds: An item: base type, properties, model and icon.

name: Placeable template
holds: A container, console, door-like prop or interactive object.

name: Door template
holds: A door: lock state, key, linked transition, scripts.

name: Merchant template
holds: A store: inventory, mark-up, mark-down.

name: Sound template
holds: A positional or ambient sound emitter.

name: Trigger template
holds: A trigger volume and the script it fires.

name: Waypoint template
holds: A named point in an area, used by scripts and map notes.

name: Encounter template
holds: A spawn encounter: creature list, difficulty, respawn.

name: Dialogue tree
holds: A conversation: entries, replies, conditionals, camera and animation.

name: Area properties
holds: Static area data: name, fog, wind, map, on-enter scripts.

name: Area instances
holds: Everything dynamically placed in an area -- creatures, placeables, triggers, sounds.

name: Module info
holds: module.ifo -- entry point, area list, module-level scripts.

name: Journal
holds: global.jrl -- quest definitions and their entry text.

name: Faction table
holds: Faction reputation matrix.

name: GUI layout
holds: Interface screen definition.

name: Path graph
holds: Pathfinding waypoint graph for an area.

name: Compiled script
holds: NWScript bytecode. What the engine actually runs.

name: Script source
holds: NWScript source. Compiled in-process to NCS, no external compiler.

name: Soundset
holds: Per-creature combat and idle voice-over mapping.

name: Lipsync
holds: Mouth-shape keyframes synchronised to a voice-over line.

name: Letter table
holds: Letter-frequency tables for random name generation.

name: Texture container
holds: Odyssey texture: DXT1/3/5, mipmaps, cubemaps, embedded TXI.

name: Texture metadata
holds: Sidecar controlling envmap, bumpmap, procedural and blending behaviour.

name: Targa texture
holds: Uncompressed texture, the usual form for an override/ texture mod.

name: Model
holds: Geometry, node tree and animations. Paired with MDX.

name: Model vertex data
holds: The vertex buffer half of a model. Useless without its MDL.

name: Area walkmesh
holds: Where the player can walk in a room, and what surface it is.

name: Door walkmesh
holds: Collision for a door in its open and closed states.

name: Placeable walkmesh
holds: Collision volume for a placeable object.

name: Room layout
holds: Which room models make up an area and where each sits in world space.

name: Visibility graph
holds: Which rooms can see which. Get this wrong and rooms vanish.

name: Audio
holds: Music, sound and voice. KOTOR uses a header-obfuscated WAV.

name: Compressed BIF
holds: Aspyr's compressed BIF variant, used on the mobile and console ports.

name: Character file
holds: A standalone player character, as used by LocalVault.

name: Palette
holds: Toolset object palette. Editor metadata, not read by the engine.

name: Aspyr OBB
holds: Mobile/console virtual filesystem. Needs xoreos-tools unobb.
